thread.title: Walmart to overtake Apple on list of biggest e-commerce retailers

author: Stocks News Feed
title: Walmart to overtake Apple on list of biggest e-commerce retailers
text:
Walmart Inc.
 WMT, -1.37%
 including the namesake retailer, Sam’s Club and Jet.com , will overtake Apple Inc.
 AAPL, -2.82%
 to take the number three spot on the ranking of the world’s largest e-commerce retailers, according to eMarketer data . In 2017 Apple had 3.8% of sales share, ahead of Walmart’s 3.3% of share. For 2018, Walmart is poised to claim 4.0%, swapping places with Apple, which will have 3.9% of share. The top two e-commerce retailers for 2018 will be Amazon.com Inc.
 AMZN, -1.97%
 with 48% and eBay Inc.
 EBAY, -0.75%
 with 7.2%. “Importantly, Walmart has one of the fastest growing e-commerce businesses,” eMarketer wrote, with 39.4% online sales while Apple’s e-commerce growth will be a little more than 18%. Walmart’s third-quarter e-commerce sales grew 43%, the company announced on Thursday. Walmart shares have gained nearly 3% for the year to date, Apple stock is up 10.4%, the Amplify Online Retail ETF
 IBUY, -0.54%
 has rallied 7.7%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average
 DJIA, -0.81%
 is up 1.5% for the period.
